bio.text: Dar'shun Kendrick represents Georgia House District 95 in East DeKalb and South Gwinnett counties; she was elected in 2010 and sworn in in 2011.

Kendrick was born and raised in Atlanta, graduated from Oglethorpe University in 2004, earned a law degree from the University of Georgia in 2007, and earned an MBA from Kennesaw State University in 2011.
In 2010 she opened Kairos Capital Legal Advisors, a corporate law and registered investment advisory firm, and she lives in Lithonia.
